text: 上海市委书记陈吉宁今天会见了新加坡丰益国际集团董事局主席兼首席执行官郭孔丰一行。陈吉宁说，刚刚召开的全国卫生与健康大会对健康中国作出系统部署，我们要树立和践行大食物观，为丰益国际等食品行业龙头企业提供新的发展机遇。欢迎把握中国市场消费结构变化和消费需求多样化趋势，持续加大在沪研发创新和业务布局力度，在健康食品、医疗服务、养老护理以及人才培养等方面深化对接合作。我们将持续营造市场化、法治化、国际化一流营商环境，常态化听取企业意见建议，提供优质高效服务，携手实现互利共赢发展。
text_en: Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining met today with a delegation led by Kuok Khoon Hong, Chairman of the Board and CEO of Singapore's Wilmar International. Chen Jining said that the recently concluded National Health Conference made systematic arrangements for Healthy China, and that we should establish and practice the Big Food concept, providing new development opportunities for leading food industry enterprises such as Wilmar International. He welcomed the company to grasp the trends of changing consumption structure and diversified consumer demand in the Chinese market, continue to increase its R&D, innovation and business layout in Shanghai, and deepen alignment and cooperation in areas such as health foods, medical services, elderly care and talent cultivation. We will continue to foster a market-oriented, law-based and internationalized first-class business environment, regularly listen to enterprises' opinions and suggestions, provide high-quality and efficient services, and work together to achieve mutually beneficial and win-win development.
